meanings.note: only when answering or making a phone call
surprise or indignation: 'Ах ты, ...!' = why, you ...!

examples.text: Ах ты, жадина! А у тебя есть телефон?
examples.trans: Oh, you greedy thing! And have you got a phone?
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence
+ dative of person + accusative of thing
imperative давай/давайте + 1st person plural or infinitive

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

related.gloss: to hand in; to take (an exam)

meanings.note: на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.
Any day now, on the website.

related.gloss: to reach, walk as far as

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you tonight?

examples.text: Позвони мне вечером. Договоримся на завтра.
examples.trans: Call me this evening. We'll arrange something for tomorrow.

examples.text: Здрасьте, а вы вообще кто и откуда пришли?
examples.trans: Hello there, and who are you anyway and where did you come from?

examples.text: Ну здрасьте, опять холодильник не работает!
examples.trans: Well hello, the refrigerator is not working again!

meanings.note: To run for a second term.

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: joins a description to a noun; agrees with that noun in gender and number

examples.trans: This is a mayor who keeps his word.
Where is the book that was here?

examples.text: Это секрет, который умрёт вместе со мной.
examples.trans: It's a secret that will die with me.

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
usually in the genitive ничего, with не: ничего не осталось

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

meanings.note: hesitation, at the start of a sentence

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.
Our hotel has to impress the guests.

examples.text: В нашем отеле действует новая услуга.
examples.trans: Our hotel has a new service.

examples.text: Кто бы мог подумать, что буду управлять отелем?
examples.trans: Who'd have thought I'd be running a hotel?
Come over, we'll have lunch and chat.
I went over and we chatted a bit.

examples.text: Не кричи на меня, я подъезжаю.
examples.trans: Don't yell at me, I'm almost there.

examples.text: Она подъезжает к ресторану и выходит из машины.
examples.trans: She pulls up to the restaurant and gets out of the car.

examples.text: Да, Саша, мы подъезжаем, вы где?
examples.trans: Yes, Sasha, we're nearly there, where are you?

meanings.en: to have lunch, eat midday meal

examples.trans: No! Right now we'll go have lunch.
It's time for us to go.

проходить.gloss: to go through; to come in

examples.text: Вика, Паша! Как я рад. Проходите, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: Vika, Pasha! I'm so glad. Come in, please.

meanings.note: Dining establishment. Borrowed from French 'restaurant' (from 'restaurer', to restore strength with rich broth); entered Russian in the early 19th century.

examples.trans: They called from the Italian restaurant.
In the evening they went to a restaurant.

examples.text: Кстати, звонили из итальянского ресторана. Дарят папе романтический ужин на двоих.
examples.trans: By the way, they called from the Italian restaurant. They're giving Dad a romantic dinner for two.

examples.text: Мы же здесь выросли. И о людях тоже надо думать.
examples.trans: After all, we grew up here. And you have to think about people too.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?
Alas, there are no pills for old age.

examples.text: Увы, тут уже ничего не поделаешь.
examples.trans: Alas, nothing can be done about it now.

examples.text: Какое хорошее утро! Лидия Алексеевна, чашку кофе, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: What a lovely morning! Lidia Alekseyevna, a cup of coffee, please.
